newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle trade slow - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle trade slow - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle area Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers were $1.00 per cwt lower, compared to last good test and heifers were steady. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 2,100 slaughter steers and 900 heifers; 19,500 head confirmed for week to date which includes 14,100 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 68.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1050 lbs 68.00.
